subject: pgvector or Qdrant? Choose the storage layer for a small RAG service
reviewer: AI-assisted visual preflight; not human publication approval
selection_method: Three original image generations were visually compared for compliance. Two were rejected because diagrams, product branding and UI elements violated the no-text/no-logo/no-schematic rule. Third independent generated image accepted for wide editorial cover.

candidate_reviews.reason: Contains pgvector/Qdrant logos, SQL/REST labels, arrows and technical UI panels; brand-heavy infographic contrary to visual constitution.
Contains large vendor labels, interface-like cards and a query/answer flowchart. Unacceptable as wordless editorial art.

Single tangible metaphor of integrated archive and physically separate retrieval cabinet joined by paper; no readable text, brands, charts, or interface. Warm architectural materials, controlled focal area.

selected_generation.generation_brief: A serene, cinematic architectural still life in a warm neutral gallery: ivory stone archive with arched shelves on the left, a separate terracotta cabinet with stacked papers to the right, and one curling parchment ribbon linking them; soft shadows, plaster, restrained materials, no branding or text.

reference_comparison.observation: Warm architectural space, sculpted physical components, fine texture and disciplined terracotta accent. Selected art shares a tangible rather than diagrammatic metaphor.
Quiet paper canvas, physically constructed mechanism and restrained material palette. Selected art is visually distinct but uses related print-like tactility.

actual_crop_review.note: Both cabinets and bridging paper remain readable, although top and bottom surroundings are cropped.
Original wide crop preserves both cabinets.
Inset side crop retains the two contrasting cabinets and link.

output.verified: Pillow encode and full decode, RIFF format/dimensions, independent local Git-blob hash, GitHub base64 blob creation and exact remote readback comparison; all passed.

alt_text: An ivory archive and a separate terracotta cabinet, linked by one unfolding paper ribbon, illustrate the choice between integrated and independent retrieval storage.
constraints: No diagram, generated results, UI, logos, model/database benchmark claims or human review claim. This record covers visual production only; article publication remains human-controlled.
